d35: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d35: 🕯️ Paola Smith is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d35: What Paola kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d35: "Paola's gone." Sara looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Paola." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d35: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Eamon blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d35: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d35: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d35: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d35: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d35: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d35: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.
d35: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d35: 📖 LEARNED: Stalk (Level 1). Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
d35: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d35: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Paola Smith, 35 days. The mantle passes to Eamon Schulz.
d35: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Eamon Schulz, 23 — a fishing guide. His hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location, Dowsing.
d35: The village's quarrel was with Paola — and Paola is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d35: At the grave, Sara speaks for Eamon — "Paola trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d35: The fire knew Eamon before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
